data.name: Arzaan
data.gender_notes: Arzaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'r-z-n', which means 'to protect, help, or aid'. In Islamic history, Arzaan is a name given to those who provide protection, support, and assistance to others. The name Arzaan carries the meaning “Protector, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arzaan usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and support, inspiring a sense of security and trust.
data.etymology: Arzaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arzaan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
